verdict_msg: HARD_FAIL (M1 CONCLUSIVELY dead): NO bge score-distribution-shape feature separates in-coverage from coverage-gap (best AUC=0.429 < 0.75). The Director's 'unknown queries are flatter' hypothesis is REFUTED on this held-out: in-coverage (present-but-paraphrased) queries are NOT more confident/peaked than coverage-gap (absent) queries. Confidence calibration of ANY shape cannot fix refuse-robustness here. M4 paraphrase-invariant retrieval is the ENABLING PRECONDITION -- it must raise in-coverage confidence so a gate becomes possible. Confirms the M4-first sequence. M1b distribution-shape separability (DECISION 34a follow-up). Best discriminating feature: flatness AUC=0.429 bal_acc=0.667 (in_cov_mean=0.0176 vs gap_mean=0.0236). n=7/6 (SMALL). Top-1 threshold M1 already FAILED in v1; this tests shape.
